STATE OF MINNESOTA
STATE PLANNING AGENCY
802 CAPITOL SQUARE BUILDING
550 CEDAR STREET
ST. PAUL, 55101
June 30, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Chief Office of Environmental Quality U.S. Department of the Interior Washington, D.C. 20240
RE: Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972 Environmental Statement
Dear Mr. Barber:
This is to certify that the Minnesota State Planning Agency has in accordance with the Project Notification and Review System (PNRS) procedures, established by Bureau of the Budget Circular A-95, reviewed the Endangered Species Conservation Act Draft Environmental Statement. State agencies which may be interested in or affected by this proposal have been notified by our office, and comments from the Minnesota State Department of Agriculture are attached.
This letter represents the final action of the State Planning Agency's review of the proposal in its performance of the function as the State Clearinghouse under the PNRS procedures.
Sincerely,
James H. Alexander
Director
Intergovernmental Planning
Control Mille Consul
